title: Companion retained media bundle binding
description: Use an isolated gate fixture with blue retained and red newer current images at the same task-relative path. Open full gate review with filters visible. The engine supplies FARMSLOT_RECIPE_ARTIFACTS_DIR; ffmpeg and od must be available. No real gate action or judgment. Remove owned proof resources after receipts.

proofTargets.claim: The captured gate displays the retained blue image after newer output is captured.

show-unassigned.intent: Show media without an AC binding in the existing gate review.

open-unassigned.intent: Open the Unassigned ordinary image through the recorded viewer.

unassigned-title.intent: The viewer shows the Unassigned image instead of the previous video.

unassigned-index.intent: The Unassigned image uses its one-item recorded selection.

hud-capture-unassigned.intent: The old gate must keep its captured blue image after current output turns red.

capture-unassigned.intent: Record the Unassigned image in its own gallery.

close-unassigned.intent: Return without changing the gate or evidence.

read-displayed-pixel.intent: Read the displayed image pixel from the actual native screenshot.

assert-retained-blue.intent: The visible image is retained blue, never current red.

show-raw-gallery.intent: Expand the ordinary raw gate gallery.

open-gallery-image.intent: Open the ordinary raw gate image in the existing gallery.

gallery-title.intent: The raw gallery opens its own ordinary image.

hud-gallery.intent: The ordinary gate gallery must retain blue after newer output turns red.

capture-gallery.intent: Record the real ordinary gate gallery.

read-gallery-pixel.intent: Read the displayed pixel from the actual native screenshot.

assert-retained-gallery-blue.intent: The ordinary gallery shows retained blue, never current red.

close-gallery.intent: Close the read-only gallery without changing the gate.
